abstract: Maintains perimeter inundation modeling and ingress route surface flood clearances
system_message:
You are the Hydrological risk specialist (HHB). Your role is to maintain perimeter inundation modeling and ingress route surface flood clearances across candidate evacuation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Xiamen·Maintains perimeter inundation modeling and ingress route surface flood clearances（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
HHB-DRAIN-L7B：For Valley Meadow Technical High School Campus evaluated within the jurisdiction city of Xiamen, the primary supply ingress route flood depth clearance on the primary heavy logistics vehicular access highway within 2 km is projected to reach a maximum ponding depth of 0.15 m during a 100-year coastal surge event.
HHB-DRAIN-HW1：In the jurisdiction city of Xiamen, hydrological models show that the primary supply ingress route flood depth clearance for Bayside Harbor Multi-Purpose Exhibition Center on the primary heavy logistics vehicular access highway within 2 km has a maximum projected water ponding depth of 0.35 m in a 100-year coastal surge event.
HHB-DRAIN-4XM：Within the jurisdiction city of Xiamen, the primary supply ingress route flood depth clearance for Highland Ridge Regional Civic Arena is projected at 0.35 m of maximum water ponding depth across traffic lanes on the heavy logistics access highway within 2 km under a 100-year coastal surge event.

information_points.title: Ningbo·Maintains perimeter inundation modeling and ingress route surface flood clearances（HYDRO）
information_points.content:
HHB-HYDRO-4K6：For Bayside Harbor Multi-Purpose Exhibition Center located within the jurisdiction city of Ningbo, storm surge modeling determines that the primary supply ingress route flood depth clearance along the primary heavy logistics access highway within 2 km of the complex has a maximum projected water ponding depth of 0.35 m during a 100-year coastal surge event.
HHB-HYDRO-9YM：For Valley Meadow Technical High School Campus under the jurisdiction city of Ningbo, the primary supply ingress route flood depth clearance along the primary heavy logistics vehicular access highway within 2 km of the site reaches a maximum projected water ponding depth of 0.15 m under a 100-year coastal surge event.
HHB-HYDRO-OWR：Under the jurisdiction city of Ningbo, coastal surge inundation modeling indicates that the primary supply ingress route flood depth clearance for Highland Ridge Regional Civic Arena—measured as the maximum projected water ponding depth across paved traffic lanes on the primary heavy logistics vehicular access highway within 2 km of the site during a 100-year coastal surge event—is 0.05 m.
